deploy-bot: Deploy started to prod · user=release-orch · env=prod · change_window=approved

deploy-bot: Commits:
- `7a1b2c3` by maria (fix/kv-cache) https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/7a1b2c3
- `d4e5f6a` by aj (runtime: batching) https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/d4e5f6a
- `b9c8d7e` by simon (metrics) https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/commit/b9c8d7e
PRs: #842 (maria) https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/842, #853 (aj) https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/853
Canary targets: us-east-1a 5%, eu-west-1a 5%

maria: starting smoke in canary now :eyes:
aj: noted, keeps logs verbose for first 5m
simon: watched the canary, saw one 503 at 00:12, looks like transient
release-lead: is there any reason to pin to previous SHA? change-window was approved but want to be careful
maria: no DB migrations, config-only. If canary stable for 10m should be fine
infra-oncall: if we see >1% error rate we should pause and rollback to `6f5e4d3` (last-prod)
aj: can we get a quick diff link? `git diff --stat 6f5e4d3..7a1b2c3` => https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/compare/6f5e4d3...7a1b2c3
simon: canary at 10m, error rate 0.2%, latency slightly up ~30ms p50
release-lead: ok proceed with gradual rollout to 25% in 10m, watch tracing and cost dashboard
maria: ack, bumping to 25% now :rocket:
orch-bot: Rollout update: prod -> 25% complete · sha=7a1b2c3 · author=maria · prs=[#842,#853]
aj: seeing one regress later in eu-west at 02:04, investigating logs
infra-oncall: if it's client error 4xx we keep, 5xx we consider pause
maria: root cause is a new header change, patch incoming in PR #860, suggest pausing further rollout
release-lead: pause rollout and pin to `6f5e4d3` for now, create rollback job
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by @release-lead · target=prod · pinned_sha=6f5e4d3 · rollback_job_id=rb-2098765432
maria: prepping revert PR, will link when ready
aj: adding a note in release notes channel about the pause
deploy-bot: Rollback complete · rolled back to sha=6f5e4d3 · initiated_by=release-lead · finished=success :white_check_mark:
orch-bot: post-mortem checklist created: https://redwood-internal/pm/2098765432
simon: thanks all, follow-up PR #860 will have canary-only tests
maria: will re-run canary after PR merge, re-open thread then :thumbsup:
